en: You have come to learn in the art of warfare, $r? You have come to the wrong place.
My money's on the goblins!  And if you have any sense then yours is too!
$n claims the blacksmith!  If left unchallenged, the Alliance will control it in 1 minute!
PEASANT CROSSES LINE.
Their spirits are restored! The gryphons are ready to strike! Come, soldiers! Come to my side!
%s reaps the Gloom Weed violently from the ground.
Well done Edward and Tyler. You are progressing along in your training quite nicely. We shall test your mettle again soon.
Information on the Blood of Heroes.
Begging your pardon, Lady Prestor. That was not my intent.
Commerce!  I crave it!
It is good that you wish to honor your kills by putting their bodies to use.  Find Thuwd inside the Kodohide Leatherworks in the middle of The Drag.
Oh no... Mist... what has happened...?
This better be the last one!
Well, that is just not right. The creature is far too small. Let us see what Keever's third batch will do.
Give me the arcana and I shall craft the amalgamation, mortal.

You continue to thumb through the journal looking for any information that might help in your search for the stolen chest.$B$BTowards the final pages of the book, in red pencil, you see a notation from James along the side of the page. It says, "Old home near Stone Cairn Lake... gnolls will work perfectly as bodyguards."$B$BThere is no reason to suggest this is where the chest is, but there doesn't seem to be any other clues.
I seek training to ride a steed.
Trogg incursion! Defend me while I blast the hole closed!
You be watchin' yerself, $c. Respect our ways, or a curse be on you and yours.

The blade and Mograine were a singular entity. Do you understand? This act corrupted the blade and lead to Mograine's own corruption as a death knight of Kel'Thuzad. I swore that if I lived, I would expose the perpetrators of this heinous crime. For two days I remained under the rot and contagion of Scourge - gathering as much strength as possible to escape the razed city.
I have lost my talisman and require a new one, Jin'rokh.
Plucky doesn't want Tirth to know he's still in the Shimmering Flats, so he turned himself into a chicken!$B$BIf you find Plucky, beckon him to you.  Maybe he'll come out of hiding.

Well met master of Rod and Reel!   If you be willing to test your skills against the best fisher-folk in the lands then listen up!   On this very Sunday there be a contest in Stranglethorn where the master angler will be chosen!

Thank the light you are here! I'd accept help from a two-headed ogre at this point.

The city has been overrun by troggs! The attempts to wipe them out resulted in mass contamination. But there is still hope.

Our scientists who evacuated to Ironforge are working on a cure for the fallout sickness. Meanwhile, if you can help me stop the trogg invasion, perhaps the city can be retaken.
Come to me again with such pathetic work and I will send you home in a small iron box that I tempered in goat urine. Now go see that idiot Ug'thok, he is better suited to your needs.

The Earth Mother watch over us; under cover of the night as in the day. Let this fire illuminate both our bodies and spirits and remind us of our honored ancestors, who are ever present and guiding our way.
Who dares disturb me?  Die $n!
Kill!
Scourge in sewers!  We need help!
Where is the Engineering trainer?

<Field Marshal Chambers growls.>$B$BSo you're the riff-raff that assisted Didier in getting the supplies here in one piece? Where are the rest of you? I know there's gotta be more. Chickens like you generally roam in huge packs.$B$BBah, just give me the damned writ so I can sign off on it.
I slay the man on the spot as my liege would expect me to do, as he is nothing more than a thief and a liar.
We will drive our foes from Silverpine, then bring the tides of war to their very capital!
The grass is soft and lush. The air is fresh, full of light and song. Everything I've seen suggests that Teldrassil is a dream come true. Why, then, is my heart full of foreboding?
Speak not your vulgar language to me!  Only Hydraxis can stand it.
